findings.title: No test for session-detail unpriced detection
findings.problem: get_session_detail's per-model unpriced detection (cli_analytics_handler.py:690-694) runs _price_cache_reads across every model_cost_rows entry, which is correctly wired, but no new or pre-existing test exercises a get_session_detail call where one of several models is absent from pricing config.
findings.impact: A regression that silently breaks per-model unpriced detection for get_session_detail would ship undetected, understating cache_read_cost_usd/bloat_pct for multi-model sessions with no warning surfaced to the caller.
findings.recommendation: Add a get_session_detail handler test with model_cost_rows containing one model absent from pricing config (lookup_cost_config returns None) among several, and assert that model appears in the returned unpriced list, mirroring the existing per-model handler test pattern used for get_sessions.
findings.resolution: Fixed in commit e419854c8 — added test_get_session_detail_unpriced_model_contributes_zero_without_breaking_total. No production code change needed.
